verdict.rationale: The DGX B300's own BMC exposes programmatic management through Redfish and IPMI alongside remote KVM and remote storage, so some API-based control of the system is documented. Nothing shows that these APIs match everything available in the BMC's interactive interface. The OpenAPI probe 404s concern the docs site, not the BMC, so they only confirm that no published API spec was found. Missing for 10: documented parity between the Redfish/IPMI APIs and the BMC web UI, an API reference or spec for the system's management surface, and hands-on evidence of fully automating UI tasks via API.
